purpose: Establish routine-operation measurement definitions before cutover; historical examples are not a representative denominator.

sourceChangeShare.definition: completed routine changes requiring a source commit / all completed routine changes in the same recorded window

websiteDeployCount.definition: actual website upgrades required by those changes; collector-only upgrades recorded separately

publicConfirmationSeconds.definition: first saved operator change to persisted matching origin/public receipt, including failed attempts and retries
